plan_review.notes: Separate uninvolved model (gpt-5.5, high effort) reviewed the synthesized plan against the real code. NO blocking flaws; core no-op truth table (LEGACY/RISK_REWARD_FUSED/NAVMESH byte-identical) confirmed sound. 3 concerns, all resolved: (1) [SHOULD-FIX] brittle non-inertness assertion — the headless 'fingerprint differs from pure NAVMESH on >=1 seed' could false-fail (coincidental match on seeds 42/101) or false-pass (coarse diff != proof the fan ran on the navmesh base). RESOLVED: headless test now asserts same-seed byte-identity ONLY; wiring/non-inertness proof moved to the deterministic unit assertion (getFusedDebug() non-null + navWaypoints populated in NAVMESH_FUSED) + the sweep navmeshFusedCompletions>0 tripwire. (2) [SHOULD-FIX] 'hard gate' navmeshFusedCompletions>=navmeshCompletions risks baking a balance comparison into the report-only sweep tool (rule #13). RECONCILED: sweep SCRIPT stays report-only + inertness-only exit; the creator's completion>=pure-NAVMESH bar is kept as an explicit SHIP criterion I evaluate from the JSON (not weakened — rule #12), and a RED gate escalates via the mandatory creator PING (ship posture 'PING on any gate red'), never a 4a retune. (3) [NICE-TO-HAVE] boolean clarity — adopted three explicit non-overlapping booleans usesNavmeshRoute / usePureNavmesh / useFused; only usePureNavmesh drives the two downstream skip gates. Plan artifact updated with all three resolutions.
